name: calo
note: CMS Phase-2 barrel and forward calorimeters (Fireworks/EventExport preset calo): ECAL barrel, HCAL barrel (HB), outer (HO) and forward (HF) rechits, drawn as eta-phi towers from their front face (x y z is the cell's front-face centre). Phase 2 has no ECAL endcap, preshower or HCAL endcap (HGCal replaces them): EcalHits are all EB, HBHEHits all HB. Tower sizes come from the exporter's dEta dPhi thickness columns (the cell's corners; measured: EB 0.017-0.019 x 0.017, HB 0.087 x 0.087 and 1-64 cm deep per depth, HF 0.11-0.30 x 0.17-0.35 and 143-165 cm). Depth: EB and HO show energy as length (one layer each; 22 cm per decade of energy from 0.5 to 45 cm, log so an electron core and a soft crystal differ (linear saturates at a few GeV), and a crystal never reaches HB at r 181 cm), HB and HF a geometric depth (several depths or fibre lengths per tower). Cuts per subdetector, as the noise levels differ (measured on the ttbar samples: EB 1 GeV, as at 0PU half of the EB hits between 0.5 and 1 GeV have no simulated energy (likely noise, truth-graph.md gap 25) and every hit above 1 GeV has; HB 1 GeV, HF 3 GeV). HO and HF start hidden; HF (r 12-130 cm, |z| 1115-1280 cm) is not drawn in the front view, where it would sit inside the barrel. Domain Calo: the barrel region, front view.
